newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SHARES TAKE OFF, BREAK 1500 RESISTANCE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SHARES TAKE OFF, BREAK 1500 RESISTANCE.

text.p: Greek shares were climbing strongly in early Monday trade with the benchmark index breaking resistance at 1,500 points with gains of 1.6 percent with brokers saying the upward trend was sustainable.

"The market's rise has been driven by strong buying interest for banks and positive macroeconomic developments. As the likelihood of negative surprises on the macro front is small the upward trend is sustainable," said Telesis Securities.
Bank shares were leading the climb, up 2.3 percent in early trade as advancers led decliners 115 to 22 on volume of 2.77 billion drachmas. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
